article.titolo: Bff Bank, in arrivo le offerte di Cerberus e CF+ mentre proseguono i contatti tra Amco e Bper per formare una cordata

verdict.text_en: The stock moved 3 sessions after the article (11 Sep 2026, +5.9%, 4.0 times the normal daily swing of the 20 sessions before the article); nothing unusual closed before publication. By 23 Sep 2026, the move has fully reversed.
